messages.text: The return records show the metal rack was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The rack’s refund would be BRL 119.00; shipping cannot be added or relabelled as an item price, because shipping charges are not included in item refunds (refund-policy/v2/amount). Since you’re asking for the delivery charge back, a staff member must review that charge (refund-policy/v2/shipping). Would you like a staff member to review it?
